title: How guard denials are recorded
note: Guards never emit HarnessToolCallDenied. Each guard returns a plain deny reason in HookDecision.message and check identity in audit_fields["check_id"]. guard_denial_identity binds the footer and registered id without parsing JSON; decision_render alone builds Claude, Codex and Cursor output. the shared hook runner records one row per denial, and one per warn or suppression_attempted outcome a guard declares in audit_fields["audit_outcome"], after the lint-config mode gate and check-id binding. The relay's client-local subset records through the denial-audit route; the hooks route records its own pre-dispatch refusals. Close-out counts these rows with yoke events query --event-name HarnessToolCallDenied. Source/unit evidence is not deployed harness proof.
